calc_sphere_points_fibonacci: generate uniformly distributed weighted points on a sphere using the golden ratio spiral algorithm
calc_sphere_points_random: generate random points on a sphere using rejection sampling with torch tensors
sample_sphere_points_golden_ratio: sample N points on a unit sphere using the Fibonacci golden angle method with density weighting
sample_sphere_points_rejection: sample N random points on a unit sphere by rejecting points outside the unit ball
weight_sphere_points_by_density: compute density-based weights for sphere points using pairwise distance exponential kernel
